notes.title: improved bot
notes.notes:
I have recently updated the rules, so that when a pawn can capture an opponent, it has to perform that capture.

This means that a player can intentionally place a piece to force a capture, which could in turn make the opponent in a more precarious position.

Until now, the bot was not taking advantage of this. But it does now, and it makes it even more challenging to beat.

notes.title: first update
notes.notes:
This version has the following changes
- the bot is stronger.
- you can change the board's look from wood to also minimalist and muted.
- and most importantly, when you can capture an opponent's pawn, you have to capture. This is a rule in checkers that I had overlooked in the first release. It really adds a good strategic layer, as you can force your opponent into bad moves.
